# case: record-txt-escapes
## problems
## notes
## check
z=example.com&r=is+quote+TXT+%22a+%5C%22quoted%5C%22+%5C%5C+back%5C124slash+%5C094+caret;+semi+'single'+caf%C3%A9%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; quote.example.com TXT
; replaces every TXT record of quote
quote 3600 IN TXT "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' café"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "quote.example.com.",
        "Type": "TXT",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "\"a \\\"quoted\\\" \\\\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' caf\\303\\251\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the quote.example.com TXT records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=quote.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add quote.example.com TXT "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' café"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"quote.example.com","content":"\"a \\\"quoted\\\" \\\\ back|slash ^ caret; semi '\''single'\'' caf\u00e9\"","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
# TXT values write ; as \; : the YamlProvider needs escaped_semicolons: true (octoDNS refuses them with false, its default from 2.0).
---
quote:
  # octoDNS's check refuses this text (characters outside ASCII, or a \ before a ;): lenient loads it with a warning
  - octodns:
      lenient: true
    ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret\\; semi 'single' caf\xe9"
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# remove the resources of any other quote.example.com TXT record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_quote" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "quote.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' café"
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_quote" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "quote.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["a \\\"quoted\\\" \\\\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' caf\\303\\251"]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: TXT records
   Name: quote.example.com
   Value:
     "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' café"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every TXT record of the name with the values above.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+quote+TXT+%22a+%5C%22quoted%5C%22+%5C%5C+back%5C124slash+%5C094+caret;+semi+'single'+caf%C3%A9%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: TXT kayıtları
   Ad: quote.example.com
   Değer:
     "a \"quoted\" \\ back|slash ^ caret; semi 'single' café"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm TXT kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+quote+TXT+%22a+%5C%22quoted%5C%22+%5C%5C+back%5C124slash+%5C094+caret;+semi+'single'+caf%C3%A9%22
